description: Kerala News: In a first for India, Kerala Police is using AI to crack down on child sexual abuse material online. The tool, Katalyst, helps sift through vast digital evidence, identify victims faster, and track perpetrators across social media platforms.
body_lead: How Kerala cops are using AI to nab paedophiles on dark web. And it's a first in India In a first for India, Kerala Police is using AI to crack down on child sexual abuse material online. The tool, Katalyst, helps sift through vast digital evidence, identify victims faster, and track perpetrators across social media platforms. "CHEEZE PIZZA", the encrypted forum's name read. Sometime in 2025, the Kerala Police's Counter Child Sexual Exploitation (CCSE) team stumbled upon the forum during routine cyber patrolling on the dark web.
